report.summary: Delta closure audit of frozen range c703fe50→8b01dfa2 (11 files), read entirely from the single frozen request.json. The correction (7839c9d9) closes the only material initial-audit finding: the C2 zero-coverage terminal path is now reachable via the installed yfinance 1.7.0 parser's explicit no-data answer, accepted only when canonical ticker, exact requested epoch bounds (midnight in the known PriceHistory timezone) and the structured yahoo_reason grammar all match and debug_info carries no status_code; every guard fails conservatively to retryable VendorUnavailableError, so no service/malformed/mismatched-window failure can become a zero receipt — compliant with the governing requirement that only an explicit provider no-data response or a verified well-formed empty counts. Per-check zero_source provenance is persisted and validated (unknown sources rejected; legacy checks default compatibly), and read/write validation now rejects resolved endpoints retaining active zero_checks, closing initial finding #4 without affecting the legitimate resolve/reopen paths (both clear checks before writing). Regressions are strong: the real installed Ticker.history→PriceHistory.history parser executes with only HTTP JSON substituted, asserting the request epochs equal the helper's expected epochs; a three-pass 14-day timeline reaches terminal with per-check provenance and no endpoint-only fetch on the fourth pass; wrong-bounds/no-timezone/service-reason/status-error cases remain retryable; the stale-check tamper with recomputed checksum is rejected at both write and load. Acceptance, plan, maintenance, vendor-context (producer file SHA-256s and bounded verbatim assignments), findings dispositions and runtime receipt (only the disposable temp root changed) are mutually consistent, and all documents honestly state that independent delta closure is pending with no integration/push/release authority claimed. No Critical, High or Medium findings; four Low observations recorded. Feature-acceptance verdict for the delta: supported for local acceptance. Merge-integrity: changed paths match the frozen manifest. Full-suite health: builder-reported 3193 passed/10 skipped/exit 0 with stdout SHA-256 recorded, consistent but not independently rerun. Remote CI: unverified (unpushed local branch), as the candidate itself declares. This conclusion grants no integration or release authority.
limitations: Frozen-evidence-only audit: no commands were run against the repository, no tests, ruff, or the DOCN replay were executed; builder receipts (3193 passed/10 skipped, focused run 31 passed, stdout SHA-256 70c398c5…, unchanged private source hashes) were checked for internal consistency only, not reproduced.

The installed yfinance 1.7.0 bodies are not in the frozen packet; vendor behavior (yahoo_reason assignment, PriceHistory.tz, debug_info status_code formatting) is verified only through the committed vendor-context excerpts/SHA-256s and the real-parser regression text, not by reading the third-party source.

Live Yahoo delivery of the exact no-data description echoing the requested epochs is unverified by design (HTTP responses substituted in tests); a differing live echo would fail conservatively to retryable, re-opening the reachability gap without any unsafe classification.

Exact-commit remote CI (Python 3.11–3.14 matrix, timezone variant, install smoke) and Machine 1 acceptance are unverified; the candidate is an unpushed local branch, as its own acceptance report states.
Private replay inputs (seven DOCN records, snapshots, cached CSV, /tmp logs) are not supplied; the runtime receipt's 35-immature figure and hash claims are accepted as builder receipts.
The initial-audit JSON embedded in the diff is the executor's own retained output; its ledger/progress figures were not independently confirmable from this packet.

findings.title: Live-echo dependence unproven: the helper requires Yahoo's error description to echo the exact requested midnight-local epochs; tests substitute the HTTP body, so if live Yahoo echoes adjusted/different epochs (or a DST-at-midnight timezone makes yfinance's period computation differ from datetime.combine fold-0), the terminal path silently reverts to retry-forever. Conservative, and disclosed in the vendor-context doc, but the C2 retry-stopping objective still rests on unverified live grammar.

Version-coupled private vendor API: the zero classification reads source._price_history.tz, exc.yahoo_reason, and a 'status_code' substring of exc.debug_info, all private yfinance 1.7.0 details pinned only by documented file hashes; any dependency change silently disables terminal zero coverage (retry-forever) with no runtime signal beyond ordinary retryable failures.

In-handler import can bypass sanitization: _explicit_settlement_zero performs 'from yfinance.exceptions import YFPricesMissingError' inside the except path of get_settlement_closes; on an incompatible install the ImportError propagates instead of the type-name-only VendorUnavailableError, skirting the deliberate no-provider-text sanitization contract (message content is benign module text, and settle_publications still reports only the exception type).

Negative-boundary cases (wrong_bounds, no_timezone, service_reason, error_status) are exercised via a SimpleNamespace stub raising YFPricesMissingError directly rather than through the installed parser, so the real parser's status/debug_info formatting for those branches is asserted only via the vendor-context trace; misclassification risk is bounded to the conservative retry direction.
